messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians celebrated in 2023.  
(If a holiday fell on a weekend, the “observed” day is shown in brackets.)

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday(s) (Observed) | Notes |
|--------------------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (Jan 1) – observed Jan 2 | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so Monday was the statutory holiday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) – Feb 20 | Family Day is a provincial holiday in several provinces. |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday (Apr 7) & Easter Monday (Apr 10) | Good Friday is a federal holiday; Easter Monday is a federal holiday for federal employees. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (May 22) | Victoria Day is a federal holiday. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (Jul 1) – observed Jul 3 | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so Monday was the statutory holiday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Sep 4) | Labour Day is a federal holiday. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Oct 9) | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (Nov 11) – observed Nov 13 | Remembrance Day is a federal holiday; observed on Monday if it falls on a weekend. |
| **Dec 23–27** | Christmas (Dec 25) & Boxing Day (Dec 26) | Christmas fell on Monday, Boxing Day on Tuesday; the weekend before (Dec 23‑24) completes the long weekend. |

**Pro‑provincial variations**

Some provinces have additional long‑weekend holidays that aren’t nationwide:

| Province | Holiday | Long‑Weekend Dates (2023) |
|----------|---------|---------------------------|
| **New Brunswick** | Saint John’s Day (Feb 21) | Feb 18‑21 |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) | Feb 18‑20 |
| **Quebec** | Saint Jean‑Baptiste Day (June 24) | Jun 22‑24 |
| **British Columbia** | BC Day (Sep 4) | Sep 2‑4 |
| **Manitoba** | Manitoba Day (June 23) | Jun 21‑23 |
| **Nova Scotia** | Natal Day (Jun 23) | Jun 21‑23 |
| **Prince Edward Island** | PEI Day (Jun 23) | Jun 21‑23 |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day (Feb 20) | Feb 18‑20 |
| **Alberta** | Family Day (Feb 20) | Feb 18‑20 |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 15‑17 |
| **Yukon** | Yukon Day (Jul 3) | Jul 1‑3 |
| **Northwest Territories** | NWT Day (Jul 3) | Jul 1‑3 |
| **Nunavut** | Nunavut Day (Jul 3) | Jul 1‑3 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • Use the “observed” dates for scheduling.  
> • For provincial holidays, you’ll need to query the user’s province or store a mapping of holidays per province.  

Let me know if you’d like the data in a CSV/JSON format or if you need additional provincial holidays!
